english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for an immediate family or household.
Use this more conceptual or written-leaning word for the family home or a home as a place of emotional belonging.

examples.english: My family consists of my dad, my mom, and me.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaa1 jau5 baa4 baa1 maa1 maa1 tung4 ngo5

examples.english: To me, home is the place where I feel most at ease.
examples.traditional: 對我嚟講，家就係最安心嘅地方。
examples.jyutping: deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 gaa1 zau6 hai6 zeoi3 on1 sam1 ge3 dei6 fong1
